steps.line: * When a debug build of palantir launches without the inspector launch flag

actions.name: probe
actions.stderr: palantir-inspect: connect /var/folders/lx/z6y2t8c92rn9hlq1k6_8fpwh0000gn/T/palantir-inspector/160.sock: No such file or directory

expect.that: .bare.pid as $p | (.listed.exit == 0 or .listed.exit == 2) and ((.listed.sockets // []) | all((.pid | tostring) != ($p | tostring)))

steps.line: * Then it creates no inspector socket
* When it launches again with the flag

expect.that: (.uid | tostring) as $u | [range(0; 340) as $k | (.["up\($k)"] // {}) + {level: $k}] | any(.exists == true and .isDirectory == true and ((.mode | tostring | explode | map(. - 48)) as $d | (if (.uid | tostring) == $u or (.uid | tostring) == "0" then $d[-2:] else $d[-3:] end) as $shut | if .level == 0 then all($shut[]; . % 2 == 0 and . < 4) else all($shut[]; . % 2 == 0) end))

steps.line: * Then it answers on a socket in a directory only the user can open
